settings.heroIntro: I build full-stack web products and the business systems behind them — React and Next.js on the front, Supabase and Firebase behind it: CRMs, dashboards, admin panels and e-commerce that replace spreadsheets and keep a company running.
settings.aboutStatement: I build web products that work as hard as you do.
aboutBio: I'm Yousry — a full-stack developer who builds websites and the systems behind them: CRMs, dashboards, admin panels and e-commerce for businesses that want more than a pretty page.

My core is the web platform itself: fast, accessible, SEO-ready interfaces written by hand — no bloated templates, no page builders. React and Next.js on the front, Supabase and Firebase on the back, with authentication, row-level security, storage and realtime wired up properly.

I model the business first — entities, roles, rules, workflows — and then build against it, so the logic lives in the database and the system keeps working when the screens change. Every project ships deployed, documented and seeded with working demo data.
